details.ask: On this gate row, press Approve to accept the item onto your list, then press Send. The step itself, in Terminal on your Mac, any time before go/no-go on Mon Dec 28 (nothing tonight waits on it): 1) run `gcloud auth application-default login` and sign in as your own account (skip if done this week); 2) paste this one line and press Return: `cd ~/Documents/Apps/hoahx/functions && node -e "const a=require('firebase-admin');const P=process.argv[1];a.initializeApp({projectId:P});const db=a.firestore();const H=r=>r==='hoa_resident'||r==='hoa_tenant';(async()=>{const s=await db.collection('hoa_membership_audit_logs').where('action','in',['platform_hoa_access_assigned','platform_hoa_access_changed']).get();console.log('logs',s.size);for(const d of s.docs){const x=d.data();const b=x.before_roles||[],f=x.after_roles||[];const gave=f.filter(H).some(r=>!b.includes(r));const ended=b.filter(H).some(r=>!f.includes(r));if(!gave&&!ended)continue;const roles=await db.collection('hoa_membership_roles').where('user_id','==',x.target_user_id).where('hoa_id','==',x.hoa_id).get();const pur=await db.collection('property_user_roles').where('user_id','==',x.target_user_id).where('hoa_id','==',x.hoa_id).where('status','==','active').get();console.log(P,gave?'GAVE':'ENDED',d.id,x.hoa_id,x.target_user_id,'|',x.reason||'(no reason)','|',roles.docs.filter(y=>H(y.data().role)).map(y=>y.id+':'+y.data().role+':'+y.data().status+':'+(y.data().property_id||'NO HOME')).join(','),'| homes',pur.size);}})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)})" hoahx-prod` 3) paste what it prints into this chat tab, headed `prod check:`. It only reads and prints; it changes nothing.
